 Our mission is to help organizations turn any growth idea into reality.

**Software Engineer, Frontend**
 We're looking for a frontend product engineer who is responsible for building out user\-facing products that help our customers translate their growth ideas into reality. As a frontend engineer on these product teams, you will play a key role in achieving Clay's vision of being a creative tool to help businesses grow by building and improving the frontend experience. You'll wear both PM and engineering hats, working with internal as well as external stakeholders to drive frontend features end to end — from ideation to deployment. There'll be no shortage of fun problems to explore and technical challenges to solve in the React ecosystem.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive product strategy and execution. You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross\-functional partners across design, data science, and GTM to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

* Up\-level the frontend codebase. Negative maintenance is one of the core values at Clay. You'll contribute to the performance/reliability of the Clay frontend and help increase development velocity of other engineers through component architecture, performance optimizations, and best practices.
* Mentor and learn from other engineers. You’ll help the team grow by mentoring other engineers in areas that you’re strong in. In return, you’ll also learn from other engineers with different strengths.


**What You’ll Bring**
* You have a proven track record of execution. You have 4\+ years of hands on engineering experience building world\-class products.

* You love to collaborate with others to ship high quality, thoughtful features. You are able to talk to customers, think through multiple approaches, and work with our teammates to find the right solution for each problem. * Having a diversity of perspectives is important to you. You believe that having people with different backgrounds and perspectives creates a better team and a more holistic product.
* You’re familiar with our current tech stack or can learn unfamiliar technologies quickly. Our current tech stack is:
+ React, Typescript, Python, Node.js
